pages.description: Most glyphs have a  school of magic  associated with  them. The elemental  schools are Fire,  Water, Air and  Earth. The other  schools are  Manipulation,  Conjuration,  Abjuration and  Anima. Magical  equipment may be  attuned to a  specific school,  giving bonuses or  discounts to spells

pages.title: Anima
pages.description: This school of magic branched out from Conjuration and Abjuration mages that tried to understand life, death and what's between. The essence tied to this school cycles between life and death, experiments suggest that it will make horses cycle between flesh, skeleton and zombie forms, but will it be the same horse as before?
